Class AuthController

java.lang.Object
com.andrei.stockportfoliobackend.controller.AuthController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/auth") public class AuthController extends Object
REST Controller responsible for handling public authentication endpoints. Allows new users to register and existing users to login and receive a JWT token.

      @PostMapping("/register") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> registerUser(@RequestBody LoginRequest signUpRequest)
